 4:53 ‘GMA’ Deals and Steals on the best of Oprah's Favorite Things Butterblu, Messermeister, MOSH, Nori By Tory Johnson November 16, 2026, 10:10 AM 
 It's Tory Johnson's exclusive "GMA"   Deals   &   Steals on the Best of Oprah's Favorite Things.
 A total of 1,808 items have been featured in the 30-year history of the celebrated Oprah's Favorite Things list. Johnson was joined by Oprah Daily creative director Adam Glassman with exclusive deals on standout picks from over the years.  
 You can also score big savings on products from brands such as Softies, LED Esthetics and more. The deals start at just $10 and are up to 55% off. Find all of Tory Johnson's   Deals   &   Steals   on her website,   GMADeals.com .

 50% off MOSH MOSH: Protein Bars
 Gift something really smart. After seeing a loved one's battle with Alzheimer's, mother-son duo Maria Shriver and Patrick Schwarzenegger co-founded MOSH, a mission-driven brain health brand. Together, with your purchase, MOSH funds Alzheimer's research to make a difference for all generations. The award-winning protein bars are built for body and mind -- high in protein for strength, brain nutrients for focus and fiber for gut health. MOSH protein bars are available in several mouth-watering flavors (Cookie Dough Crunch, Chocolate Brownie Crunch, Lemon White Chocolate Crunch, and more) with plant-based options, too. Each bar contains at least six brain ingredients including Cognizin Citicoline (clinically proven to support focus and attention), lion's mane, ashwagandha, omega-3s, vitamin B12, and vitamin D3. The newest High Protein bars deliver 20 grams of protein, 7 grams of fiber, 3 grams of sugar and creatine. Shipping is $5.99. $13.50 - $29.50

 Shop Now 50% off Nori Nori: The Nori Press
 Ditch the ironing board, and steam, press, and iron your clothes with one device. The Nori Press is perfect for on the go -- lightweight, compact, and fits in any carry-on. Designed to cut ironing time in half by allowing you to iron the front and back of your garment at the same time. It features six fabric-specific heat settings, a steam function, elongated arms for better reach, and dual-heated aluminum plates that press both sides of a garment at the same time. Automatic shutoff after 10 minutes of no movement, preventing accidents and conserving energy. Shipping is $7.99. $60

 Level up kitchen performance with Messermeister's precision-crafted knives. The Avanta Pakkawood 10-Piece Knife Block Set brings together the blades for chopping herbs, slicing crusty bread, carving a roast and tackling every prep job in between. Forged from German X50 stainless steel, the knives deliver lasting sharpness, durability and confident performance meal after meal. Rich brown Pakkawood handles add warmth and timeless style, while the countertop block keeps your go-to tools organized and within reach. From Tuesday-night dinner prep to the holiday feast, this versatile kitchen knife set has the right blade for the job and looks pretty good sitting on the counter too. Additional sets are also available. Folding knife sets elevate outdoor cooking and dining for the adventurer on your list. Limit three per order. Shipping is $11.99. $40 - $225

 Add layers of style and warmth without the bulk. Designed for your real, "running out the door" life, Orolay creates styles that move with you. The bestselling Oversized Classic Puffer Vest is easy to throw on over sweaters or a hoodie, designed to be lightweight and breathable. The large pocket design provides ample space for storing small items like phones, wallets and keys. The Fleece-Lined Hooded Parka features a cozy fleece lining, an adjustable drawstring waist for a flattering fit and five functional pockets -- the ideal combination of warmth, style and comfort. The Puff-O Classics Short Oversized Down Coat features 700+ fill power RDS-certified duck down for lightweight warmth. Designed with a relaxed fit for everyday ease and waterproof and windproof protection to take on winter adventures. Choose from fun colors! Limit five per product.  Shop Now 50% off Stingray Spot Remover Stingray Spot Remover: Cleaning Solution
 Erase stains like magic. From automotive grease stains, juice spills on the carpet, makeup, pets, or even as a laundry pre-spotter, Stingray Spot Remover gets the job done. The solution works by penetrating deep into the fibers, helping to break down stains on contact, without discoloring the affected area, which is why it was named an Oprah Favorite after a costume designer instantly removed chocolate from Oprah's white pants while backstage at a Broadway show. Stingray Spot Remover is nontoxic, biodegradable, and has no added scents, so it is safe to have around your family and pets. Available in quart, gallon and two spot-spray-sized options.
